At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.The PositionA healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.At Roche, we believe precision medicine radically improves lives. Our Global CAP/CLIA laboratories are the "heartbeat" of diagnostic innovation, bridging the gap between early research and life-saving commercial diagnostics. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise in tissue-based diagnostics and immunoassay automated testing.You will be responsible for the operational excellence of the lab, ensuring that both the Histology/Pathology and Immunoassay/Chemistry departments function at peak efficiency while maintaining total compliance with ISO15189, CAP (College of American Pathologists) and CLIA regulations.The OpportunityYou will oversee a dual-specialty laboratory at the forefront of the industry. Your leadership will span two critical domains:* Anatomic Pathology: Managing high-complexity tissue-based diagnostics, including advanced Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ Hybridization (ISH)* Immunoassay Excellence: Driving peaks of operational efficiency in our automated immunoassay tracks on state-of-the-art cobas® platformsYou will also be a key driver in our Digital Pathology transformation, integrating whole-slide imaging and AI-based image analysis into routine clinical workflows to set new standards for diagnostic precision. Your key responsibilities:* Visionary Operational Leadership: Supervise the daily "rhythm" of the lab, synchronizing pathology and immunoassay workflows to ensure competitive turnaround times (TAT)* Guardian of Quality: Maintain an "inspection-ready" culture, serving as the primary lead for CAP/CLIA and ISO 15189 audits* Champion of People: Lead, mentor, and inspire team of Laboratory scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence* Strategic Technical Oversight: Manage the validation and implementation of new assays and novel platforms, ensuring every piece of equipment is a high-performing component of our diagnostic system* Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche nameWho you are* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology, or a related Biological Science. A Master’s (MHA/MBA) or PhD is highly preferred.* Furthermore, you have 5+ years of experience in a clinical laboratory setting* Proven expertise in both anatomic pathology and automated immunoassay workflows is a distinct advantage* The ideal candidate isn't just a technical expert; You are a leader who fosters a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement with at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role* You live the Roche mindset by maintaining a track record of zero-deficiency inspections and a passion for navigating the complexities of emerging global regulationsYour Application Please submit your updated CV. About JetBrainsWe create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.What you’ll doWe build Qodana to bring the intelligence of JetBrains IDEs directly into the CI/CD pipeline, helping engineering teams spot security flaws, license issues, and bugs before they ever reach production. As AI-assisted coding grows, the need for deep, static code analysis is more critical than ever.In this role, you’ll join our Qodana Core team to expand our static analysis engine and design new algorithms for complex, inter-procedural code analysis. You will have direct ownership over how we configure and orchestrate these analyses across different environments. You’ll collaborate closely with other JetBrains compiler and IDE teams, directly influencing how development teams worldwide maintain code quality and adopt AI safely.Day to day, you will:- Design and implement new static analysis checks, rules, and inter-procedural analysis algorithms.- Extend Qodana’s capabilities in critical areas like license compliance, security, and vulnerability detection.- Optimize how code analysis runs, configure execution paths, and orchestrate performance based on project context.- Build and refine CI/CD integrations to make Qodana easy to adopt across different development workflows.- Collaborate with compiler and IDE teams across JetBrains to share insights and align analysis engines.- Take ownership of features from early concept to release, gathering feedback and iterating to make them better.What you’ll bring- A deep curiosity about code structure, compilers, and how static analysis works.- A proactive mindset, not waiting for permission to fix a broken process or improve a system.- Strong collaboration skills and a readiness to support your technical ideas with clear, logical reasoning.- Comfort working in a distributed team across different countries and time zones.- A focus on quality over quick fixes, valuing long-term maintainability in your work.- Experience with developer tooling, static analysis, application security, or LLM-based applications would be a plus. Familiarity with languages and ecosystems beyond the JVM – such as C++, Rust, JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, .NET, or Go – would also be valuable.What you’ll need- Deep, practical knowledge of JVM development (such as Kotlin or Java).- Experience designing and implementing complex algorithms or handling performance-critical backend architectures.- Fluent communication skills in English to collaborate with team members globally.What success looks like- **First 3 months:** You will get familiar with the Qodana codebase and the IntelliJ Platform architecture, delivering your first set of analysis rules and integrations.- **First 6 months:** You will take full ownership of specific analysis features, collaborating with neighboring teams to design robust solutions for complex codebases.- **Long term:** You will help shape the technical direction of Qodana Core, continuously raising the bar for static analysis performance and developer experience.Why join JetBrains?- Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.- Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.- Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.- Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.- Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.- Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.- Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.- Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.We are an equal opportunity employer.
